snapshot.text: Mandatory health insurance system run by the national insurance company (CNAM). The 2026 budget raises funding for compensated medicines and free services; the ministry plans to regionalise hospital services by 2030.

priorities.title: Primary care, screening and digitalisation
priorities.text: 2026 priorities are primary care, broader cancer screening and immunisation, community rehabilitation and palliative care, and faster digitalisation.

priorities.title: Regional hospital network by 2030
priorities.text: The ministry is preparing to regionalise hospital services by 2030.

priorities.title: No VAT on medicines
priorities.text: The health ministry rejected a reform that would put 20% VAT on medicines.
